name: singlet_clustering_cell_partitioning
title: Partition cells into clusters at fixed granularity
description: Assigns each cell of a .singlet dataset one hard cluster label, by default with Leiden modularity optimisation on a kNN graph built from obsm/<embedding_key> or a precomputed graph in obsp/<graph_key>; louvain and kmeans (fixed K) are alternatives. Needs an embedding such as X_pca (run dimensionality reduction first). Writes obs/<cluster_key> plus uns/<cluster_key> with parameters, modularity and, only when evaluation.label_key is given, agreement metrics. Do not use it to choose the resolution or number of clusters without labels (use clustering.resolution_selection), to test cluster stability, or to tune the resolution on the labels that score the result unless evaluation.tune_resolution is set deliberately and the output is reported as label-tuned.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: leiden: default, graph method with modularity or CPM. louvain: graph method, modularity only, published comparator. kmeans: fixed K on the embedding.

resolution.description: Granularity gamma for leiden and louvain; larger values tend to give more clusters. Ignored by kmeans. Defaults differ between tools.

n_clusters.description: Target number of clusters K. Required for kmeans; ignored by leiden and louvain.

input.description: Where cells and graph come from.

embedding_key.description: obsm key with the embedding; builds the graph when graph_key is null and is used directly by kmeans.

graph_key.description: obsp key with a precomputed weighted graph; null builds a kNN graph from embedding_key. Refused for kmeans.

n_pcs.description: Leading embedding columns used; set to the k chosen by dim-reduction.pc_number_selection when available.

n_neighbors.description: Neighbours per cell for the in-call kNN graph; ignored when graph_key is set.

leiden.description: Options used only when method is leiden.

n_iterations.description: Iteration limit; -1 iterates until no node moves, a positive value caps the iterations; 0 is invalid.

objective.description: Quality function: modularity with resolution gamma, or the constant Potts model.

evaluation.description: Agreement with reference labels; labels never influence the partition unless tune_resolution is true.

label_key.description: obs column with reference labels; when set, metrics and the contingency table are written.

tune_resolution.description: Choose resolution as the NMI-maximising grid value against label_key. Label-circular: output is flagged tuned_on_labels. Graph methods only.

resolution_grid.description: Resolutions searched when tune_resolution is true; null uses 0.2, 0.4, ..., 2.0 (scIB grid).

cluster_key.description: Output name: writes obs/<cluster_key> and uns/<cluster_key>. Existing members are replaced only when overwrite is true.

seed.description: Random seed for local-move order and k-means seeding.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated seconds, peak memory and device without writing anything.

overwrite.description: Replace existing obs/<cluster_key> and uns/<cluster_key> members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/partition, uns/partition/params. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, n_clusters, resolution, modularity, smallest_cluster, disconnected_clusters, tuned_on_labels and, when label_key is set, a metrics object with ari, nmi, ami, homogeneity, completeness, purity, matched_f1_macro and n_reference_classes. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
